items.source: On Windows, follow these instructions to install either GraalVM or Liberica Native Image Kit in version 25, the Visual Studio Build Tools and the Windows SDK. Due to the Windows related command-line maximum length, make sure to use x64 Native Tools Command Prompt instead of the regular Windows command line to run Maven or Gradle plugins.
items.translation: 在 Windows 上，请按照这些说明安装版本 25 的GraalVM或Liberica Native Image Kit，以及 Visual Studio Build Tools 和 Windows SDK。 由于与Windows 相关的命令行最大长度限制，请确保使用 x64 Native Tools Command Prompt（而非常规 Windows 命令行）来运行 Maven 或 Gradle 插件。

items.source: As with the buildpacks support, you need to make sure that you’re using spring-boot-starter-parent in order to inherit the native profile and that the org.graalvm.buildtools:native-maven-plugin plugin is used.
items.translation: 与构建包支持一样，您需要确保使用spring-boot-starter-parent以继承native配置文件，并且使用了org.graalvm.buildtools:native-maven-plugin插件。

items.source: The spring-boot-starter-parent declares a native profile that configures the executions that need to run in order to create a native image. You can activate profiles using the -P flag on the command line.
items.translation: `spring-boot-starter-parent` 声明了一个 `native` 配置文件，该文件配置了创建原生镜像时需要执行的执行任务。您可以通过命令行上的 `-P` 标志激活配置文件。

items.source: With the native profile active, you can invoke the native:compile goal to trigger native-image compilation:
items.translation: 启用 native` 配置后，您可以调用 native:compile` 目标来触发 native-image 编译：

items.source: Using Spring Boot support for Cloud Native Buildpacks with the Paketo Java Native Image buildpack to generate a lightweight container containing a native executable.
items.translation: 使用 Spring Boot支持 Cloud Native Buildpacks与Paketo Java Native Image buildpack，生成包含原生可执行文件的轻量级容器。

items.source: Docker should be installed. See Get Docker for more details. Configure it to allow non-root user if you are on Linux.
items.translation: Docker 应已安装。有关更多详细信息，请参阅 获取 Docker。如果您使用的是 Linux，请配置它以允许非 root 用户。

items.source: To build the image, you can run the spring-boot:build-image goal with the native profile active:

items.source: The Spring Boot Gradle plugin automatically configures AOT tasks when the GraalVM Native Image plugin is applied. You should check that your Gradle build contains a plugins block that includes org.graalvm.buildtools.native.
items.translation: Spring Boot Gradle 插件在应用 GraalVM Native Image 插件时会自动配置 AOT 任务。 您应检查您的 Gradle 构建是否包含一个包含 org.graalvm.buildtools.native` 的 plugins 块。

items.source: We need an example application that we can use to create our native image. For our purposes, the simple "Hello World!" web application that’s covered in the Developing Your First Spring Boot Application section will suffice.
items.translation: 我们需要一个示例应用程序，以便创建我们的原生镜像。就我们的目的而言，开发第一个 Spring Boot 应用程序部分中涵盖的简单“Hello World!"Web 应用程序已足够。

items.source: Spring Boot supports building Docker images containing native executables, using Cloud Native Buildpacks (CNB) integration with both Maven and Gradle and the Paketo Java Native Image buildpack. This means you can just type a single command and quickly get a sensible image into your locally running Docker daemon. The resulting image doesn’t contain a JVM, instead the native image is compiled statically. This leads to smaller images.
items.translation: Spring Boot 支持使用 Cloud Native Buildpacks (CNB) 集成（包括 Maven 和 Gradle）以及 Paketo Java Native Image buildpack，构建包含原生可执行文件的 Docker 镜像。 这意味着您只需输入一个命令，即可快速将合理的镜像推送到本地运行的 Docker 守护进程。 生成的镜像不包含 JVM，而是静态编译原生镜像。 这导致镜像更小。

items.source: Once you have run the appropriate build command, a Docker image should be available. You can start your application using docker run:
items.translation: 运行适当的构建命令后，Docker 镜像应该已经可用。您可以使用 docker run 启动应用程序：

items.source: To build a native image using the Native Build Tools, you’ll need a GraalVM distribution on your machine. You can either download it manually on the Liberica Native Image Kit page, or you can use a download manager like SDKMAN!.
items.translation: 要使用原生构建工具构建原生镜像，您需要在机器上安装 GraalVM 发行版。您可以手动从 Liberica Native Image Kit 页面 下载，或者使用 SDKMAN! 等下载管理器。

items.source: To install the native image compiler on macOS or Linux, we recommend using SDKMAN!. Get SDKMAN! from sdkman.io and install the Liberica GraalVM distribution by using the following commands:
items.translation: 要在 macOS 或 Linux 上安装原生图像编译器，我们推荐使用 SDKMAN!。从sdkman.io获取 SDKMAN!，并使用以下命令安装 Liberica GraalVM 发行版：

items.source: Verify that the correct version has been configured by checking the output of java -version:
items.translation: 通过检查 java -version 的输出，验证已配置正确的版本：

items.source: The native image executable can be found in the target directory.
items.translation: 原生镜像可执行文件位于target目录中。

items.source: When the Native Build Tools Gradle plugin is applied to your project, the Spring Boot Gradle plugin will automatically trigger the Spring AOT engine. Task dependencies are automatically configured, so you can just run the standard nativeCompile task to generate a native image:
items.translation: 当将 Native Build Tools Gradle 插件应用到您的项目时，Spring Boot Gradle 插件会自动触发 Spring AOT 引擎。任务依赖关系已自动配置，因此您只需运行标准的nativeCompile任务即可生成原生镜像：

items.source: The native image executable can be found in the build/native/nativeCompile directory.
items.translation: 原生镜像可执行文件位于 build/native/nativeCompile 目录中。

items.source: There are two main ways to build a Spring Boot native image application:
items.translation: 构建 Spring Boot 原生镜像应用程序主要有两种方法：

items.source: Using GraalVM Native Build Tools to generate a native executable.
items.translation: 使用 GraalVM 原生构建工具生成原生可执行文件。

items.source: To recap, our main application code looks like this:
items.translation: 回顾一下，我们的主应用程序代码如下所示：

items.source: This application uses Spring MVC and embedded Tomcat, both of which have been tested and verified to work with GraalVM native images.
items.translation: 此应用程序使用 Spring MVC 和嵌入式 Tomcat，两者均已测试并验证可与 GraalVM 原生镜像协同工作。

items.source:
If you want to generate a native executable directly without using Docker, you can use GraalVM Native Build Tools.
Native Build Tools are plugins shipped by GraalVM for both Maven and Gradle.
You can use them to perform a variety of GraalVM tasks, including generating a native image.
items.translation: 如果您想在不使用 Docker 的情况下直接生成原生可执行文件，可以使用 GraalVM Native Build Tools。Native Build Tools 是 GraalVM 为 Maven 和 Gradle 提供的插件。您可以使用它们来执行各种 GraalVM 任务，包括生成原生镜像。

items.source: The easiest way to start a new native Spring Boot project is to go to start.spring.io, add the GraalVM Native Support dependency and generate the project. The included HELP.md file will provide getting started hints.
items.translation: 启动新的原生 Spring Boot 项目最简单的方法是前往 start.spring.io，添加 GraalVM Native Support 依赖并生成项目。 包含的 HELP.md 文件将提供入门提示。

items.source: The CNB builder used for the images is paketobuildpacks/builder-noble-java-tiny:latest. It has a small footprint and reduced attack surface. It does not include a shell and contains a reduced set of system libraries. If you need more tools in the resulting image, you can use paketobuildpacks/ubuntu-noble-run:latest as the run image.
items.translation: 用于构建镜像的 CNB 构建器是 paketobuildpacks/builder-noble-java-tiny:latest。它具有较小的占用空间并减少了攻击面。它不包含 shell，且包含减少的系统库集。如果您需要在生成的镜像中包含更多工具，可以使用 paketobuildpacks/ubuntu-noble-run:latest 作为run 镜像。

items.source: On macOS, it is recommended to increase the memory allocated to Docker to at least 8GB, and potentially add more CPUs as well. See this Stack Overflow answer for more details. On Microsoft Windows, make sure to enable the Docker WSL 2 backend for better performance.
items.translation: 在 macOS 上，建议将分配给 Docker 的内存增加到至少 8GB，并可能增加更多 CPU。 有关更多详细信息，请参阅此 Stack Overflow 答案。 在 Microsoft Windows 上，请确保启用 Docker WSL 2 后端 以获得更好的性能。

items.source: If you don’t want to use spring-boot-starter-parent you’ll need to configure executions for the process-aot goal from Spring Boot’s plugin and the add-reachability-metadata goal from the Native Build Tools plugin.
items.translation: 如果您不想使用 spring-boot-starter-parent，则需要配置 Spring Boot 插件的 process-aot 目标的执行步骤以及 Native Build Tools 插件的 add-reachability-metadata 目标的执行步骤。

items.source: You have to build your application with at least JDK 25, because Buildpacks use the same GraalVM native-image version as the Java version used for compilation.
items.translation: 您必须使用至少 JDK 25 构建应用程序，因为 Buildpacks 使用的 GraalVM native-image 版本与用于编译的 Java 版本相同。
